{{recipe}}

This is a side dish that may be eaten with spicy [[Cookbook:Dal|dhaal]], or with spicy "sour" [[Cookbook:Chutney|chutney]] (similar to [[Cookbook:Mango Chutney|mango chutney]]).

==Ingredients==
*½ [[Cookbook:Pint|pt]] split [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]], or 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]] ground split pea flour
*½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Flour|flour]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*2–3 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], ground 
*1 [[Cookbook:Beating|beaten]] [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Turmeric|turmeric]]
*½ teaspoon ground [[Cookbook:Gheera|gheera]] (cumin)
*[[Cookbook:Oil|Oil]] for [[Cookbook:Frying|frying]]

==Procedure==
#If using whole split peas, soak overnight in lightly salted cold water, lightly salted. Drain and grind finely using a mill or [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]].
#Mix all the ingredients, adding enough water to make a dropping consistency.
#Drop dollops of batter into hot oil, squishing through thumb and forefinger to make balls about ¾ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] in diameter.
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] until golden brown, remove from oil, and drain on brown paper or [[Cookbook:Paper Towel|kitchen towel]].
